stage-07.description: Use traces and evaluation evidence to decide what is safe and worthwhile to ship.

stage-08.title: Graphs, Delegation & Multi-Agent Systems
stage-08.description: Add orchestration only when decomposition creates more value than coordination cost.

stage-09.title: Production Architecture & Capstones
stage-09.description: Integrate the layers and own a defensible production release decision.
